transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I just… I don’t feel like myself anymore. I used to hike, coach, play guitar, call people back, stay on top of things. Lately I’ve stopped doing all of that.

Some days I’m just sitting in my rental for hours, knowing there are things I need to do, but I can’t get myself to start. It’s not like me, and it’s gotten pretty bad.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been about a year and two months, I guess. Things started unraveling after I moved into the smaller rental after my divorce. Since then it’s just kept getting worse.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in most things for most of the day, more days than not?

Yeah… I wouldn’t say it’s just feeling sad all the time, but I’ve definitely lost interest in things I used to care about. I stopped hiking, stopped coaching, barely touch my guitar, and I don’t really call people back.

Most days I’m just kind of sitting there in my rental, knowing I need to do things, but I can’t get myself going. It feels like I’m not myself anymore.
Have these symptoms been pretty much constant for the past two years, or have there been periods where you felt more like yourself?

No, not two years. It’s been more like about a year and two months. It started after I moved into that smaller rental after the divorce, and since then things have just been unraveling. I haven’t really had a stretch where I felt fully like myself again.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in most things for most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, most days. I don’t feel like myself anymore. I’ve stopped doing pretty much everything I used to care about—hiking, coaching, playing guitar. I don’t call people back much either.

Some days I just sit in that small rental for hours, knowing there are things I need to do, but I can’t make myself start.
Have you noticed that you feel fatigued or lacking in energy, even when you haven’t done much physically?

Yeah. It’s like I don’t even have the energy to start things. I’ll sit in that small rental for hours, knowing there are things I should do, and I just… don’t move on them.

I stopped hiking and coaching, barely play guitar anymore, and I don’t really call people back. Mostly I just don’t feel like myself.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy things that used to bring you pleasure, like hiking, coaching, or playing guitar?

Yeah. I don’t really get much out of those things anymore. Hiking, coaching, playing guitar… I used to care about all of that, and now I just don’t do it.

Mostly I just don’t feel like myself. I don’t call people back much either. Some days I’m just sitting there in that small rental, knowing I need to do things, and I can’t make myself start.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately—like eating less than usual or losing weight without trying?

I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track of my weight, and I haven’t noticed my clothes fitting differently or anything. My eating is kind of irregular, but I can’t say I’ve clearly lost weight or been eating a lot less.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or like you're not worth much lately, even when there's no clear reason for it?

I don’t know. I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling guilty for no reason or like I’m worthless exactly. I just feel off, like I’m not doing what I should be doing, but I haven’t really thought of it as guilt.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or that you can't sit still and feel restless?

Yeah… restless, I guess. On patrol I started moving before I could really think it through. I’d crouch behind counters, signal people to get back, repeat what someone had just said to see if it meant something, and then pace the same route over and over.

It got to where the staff looked scared of me, so… yeah, I wasn’t acting normal.
Have you ever felt like life isn’t worth living or thought about hurting yourself?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve been thinking about hurting myself, no. And I haven’t really sat there thinking life isn’t worth living. I’ve just been overwhelmed, but not in that way.
Before this current period that started after your move, did you ever have a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember a clear stretch like that before the move—like two weeks where I was definitely down or not interested in anything. Nothing stands out to me that way.
Have you ever had a period before this one, lasting at least a couple of weeks, where you felt down or lost interest in most activities—even if it didn’t last as long as this current episode?
No, I don’t think so. I can’t point to a couple weeks before this where I was down like that or didn’t care about most things. Nothing like that really comes to mind.

Can you think back and confirm if there was ever a time before this current period—lasting at least a few weeks—when you felt down or lost interest in most activities, even if it wasn’t as severe or long-lasting as what you’re experiencing now?
I don’t think so. I’ve been trying to look back, but I can’t remember a period before this where it went on for a few weeks like that. Nothing really stands out as the same kind of thing.

Can you recall if your current period of feeling down and losing interest in things is the first time you’ve felt this way, or if you’ve had similar experiences in the past, even if they were shorter or less intense?

I think this is the first time it’s been like this. Mostly I just don’t feel like myself anymore. I stopped hiking, stopped coaching, I don’t play guitar, and I don’t really call people back. Some days I just sit in that little rental for hours, knowing there are things I should do, but I can’t get myself to start.
